name: postey
description: Draft, schedule and publish social posts across X, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Facebook and Pinterest. Reshape one draft per network against each one's real limits, keep everything a draft until you approve, and hand back a share link.

interface.shortDescription: Write once, publish to nine social networks
interface.longDescription: Postey turns your agent into a social media manager. Write a post once and it is reshaped for each network against that network's real character limits, hashtag conventions and format — never one caption pasted nine times. Everything stays a draft until you say publish, and scheduling counts as publishing, so nothing goes out without your approval. Reads your connected accounts rather than assuming them, and every task ends with a share link you can send to a reviewer.
defaultPrompt: Draft a post about this and show me a version for each of my platforms
Turn this video into a reel caption for Instagram and TikTok
What's scheduled this week, and did last week's posts actually go out?
